name: Illustrations (AD & prompts)
description: A reusable illustration system containing art-direction rules, generation prompts, model settings, and the resulting visual assets.
readme:
# Illustrations (AD & prompts)

The AI-generated illustration system: a **prompt library + style rules + generated assets**.

Each entry pairs a prompt (with the model + settings used) to its rendered asset, so a
niche's illustrations stay on-brand and reproducible. Style is driven by the per-app
**universe** (palette / mood from the purity tool). Version prompts next to their outputs.
